Bash(/tmp/test-og-locale-consistency.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

echo "Testing og:locale consistency across tool categories..."
echo ""

INCONSISTENT_COUNT=0
CONSISTENT_COUNT=0

# Test a representative sample from each category
declare -a TEST_PAGES=\(
  "/image/background-remover"
  "/image/collage-maker"
  "/file/csv-to-excel"
  "/file/excel-to-csv"
  "/pdf/merge-pdf"
  "/pdf/split-pdf"
  "/video-audio/video-to-gif"
  "/video-audio/trim-video"
  "/social-text/hashtag-generator"
  "/social-text/instagram-line-break"
  "/utility/qr-code-generator"
  "/utility/word-counter"
\)

for url in "${TEST_PAGES[@]}"; do
  kr_response=$\(curl -s -H "CF-IPCountry: KR" http://localhost:3000$url\)
  og_locale=$\(echo "$kr_response" | grep -o '<meta property="og:locale" content="[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4\)
  
  if [[ "$og_locale" == "ko_KR" ]]; then
    echo "✓ $url - og:locale correctly set to ko_KR"
    \(\(CONSISTENT_COUNT++\)\)
  else
    echo "✗ $url - og:locale is $og_locale \(should be ko_KR\)"
    \(\(INCONSISTENT_COUNT++\)\)
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "Summary: $CONSISTENT_COUNT consistent, $INCONSISTENT_COUNT inconsistent"

EOF)
